data.name: Abrash
data.gender_notes: Abrash is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'abar', meaning 'father'. The suffix 'sh' denotes 'multitudes'. This name is a reminder of the fatherly role and love of Allah towards His creation. The name Abrash carries the meaning “Father of multitudes” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abrash usually hope their child will grow to embody father of multitudes and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies the boundless love and care of Allah towards His creation.
data.etymology: Abrash belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of multitudes.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abrash total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: أبراش
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني الشخص الذي يمتلك العزم و الإرادة القوية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أبراش هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الشخص الذي يمتلك العزم و الإرادة القوية و الثبات في مواجهة التحديات و الصعوبات. و يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة و الصبر و الإيمان.

in_urdu.name: ابراش
in_urdu.meaning: ایک مضبوط اور ثابت قدم شخص کے لئے ایک نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: ابراش ایک عربی मूल کا مذکر نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے ایک مضبوط اور ثابت قدم شخص. یہ نام ان خصوصیات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو ایک مسلمان کو اپنے دین اور دنیا میں مضبوط بناتی ہیں. اس نام کا انتخاب کرنے والے والدین اپنے بچے کے لئے مضبوطی اور ثبات کی 바람ت کرتے ہیں.

in_hindi.name: अब्राश
in_hindi.meaning: एक मजबूत और स्थिर व्यक्ति के लिए एक नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: अब्राश एक अरबी मूल का पुल्लिंग नाम है जिसका अर्थ है एक मजबूत और स्थिर व्यक्ति. यह नाम उन गुणों को दर्शाता है जो एक मुसलमान को अपने धर्म और दुनिया में मजबूत बनाते हैं. इस नाम का चयन करने वाले माता-पिता अपने बच्चे के लिए मजबूती और स्थिरता की कामना करते हैं.

in_pashto.name: ابراش
in_pashto.meaning: د قوي او ټينګ اراده لرونکي سړي لپاره يو نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: ابراش د عربي اصلي مذکر نوم دی چې مطلب يې د قوي او ټينګ اراده لرونکي سړي لپاره يو نوم. دا نوم هغه ځانګړتي لري چې يو مسلمان په خپل دين او دنياوي چارو کې قوي او ټينګ کوي. ددې نوم د انتخابولو والدين خپل بچي ته د قوت او ثبات هيله کوي.

in_english.name: Abrash
in_english.meaning: A person with strong will and determination
in_english.long_meaning: Abrash is a masculine given name of Arabic origin. It stems from the Arabic root 'abr' which means 'to be strong' or 'to be firm'. The name Abrash signifies a person with strong will, determination, and resilience. In Islamic tradition, names are believed to influence a person's character and destiny. Abrash, with its connotations of strength and steadfastness, is chosen by parents who wish their child to embody these qualities. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting its positive and empowering meaning.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Abrash" has a rich cultural significance, particularly in the Arab world. The use of the name reflect the deep-rooted Arabic tradition of honoring the role of the father figure, whether in the family unit or in society as a whole. Moreover, the name has a distinct Arabic origin, and such cultural associations are often seen as important aspects of one's identity within that community.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name "Abrash" carries a powerful message of Allah's infinite love and care for His creation. The name "Aba" (father) is a common epithet for Allah in Islamic devotional traditions. Additionally, the suffix 'sh' signifying 'multitudes' highlights the loving and compassionate nature of the Creator, as the verse in the Quran says, "It is Allah who raised you up after your mother's weaning, and has given you hearing and sight and intelligence and affluence and comfort. But as for disobedience - that is a manifest loss" (Al-Qasas, 28:4-6). By calling one's self or another by the name "Abrash," one is reminded of their dependence and reliance on Allah as their loving Father.
